'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Nicolae Borota DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nicolae Borota]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Emperors Pawns
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
